links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT answers on repeat query of surgical questions
links.effect: Upon repeat query, the answer selected varied for 36.4% of inaccurate questions; response accuracy changed for 6/16 questions.
links.quote: Upon repeat query, the answer selected by ChatGPT varied for 36.4% of inaccurate questions; the response accuracy changed for 6/16 questions.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-4 on surgical knowledge exam questions
links.effect: ChatGPT correctly answered 71% and 68% of multiple-choice SCORE and Data-B questions; errors included inaccurate information in complex (36.4%) and fact-based (25.0%) questions.
links.quote: ChatGPT correctly answered 71% and 68% of multiple-choice SCORE and Data-B questions, respectively.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the benchmark performance and response consistency/stability of GPT-4 on surgical knowledge assessment questions (SCORE and Data-B).
